subject: Bugbear Stalker
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait. Outline art only. Keep the same crawlway: low stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden hatch ahead, one large sack in his right hand. A tall bugbear stalker creeps forward. His left hand makes a quiet shh: the index finger is pressed against his lips. The other fingers are folded down against the palm. This must not look like a middle finger. Not a raised bird. Not an insult gesture. Same bugbear family: large hairy goblinoid, blunt snout, short pointed ears, fur in large clumps. Bold even outlines. No black fills, no page frame.
